scope: Source transcription amendment for D8 only; inspected page 6 visual and registered PDF text. All inventoried theorems and dependency choices remain unchanged.
finding: The original PDF prints nu_i, without a t subscript, in the average defining nu-tilde_t; the saved statement had silently replaced it with nu_it. Restore nu_i exactly and retain the ambiguity with the surrounding time-dependent mean-path definition.

changes.before:
Letting $\nu_{it}=\mu_i+\delta_i I(t>\tau_i)$, we may re-write model (2.1) as
\[
X_{it}=\nu_{it}+\epsilon_{it},\quad t=1,\cdots,T,\ i=1,\cdots,N.
\]
(3.1)
Define
\[
\widetilde X_t=\frac1N\sum_{i=1}^N X_{it},\quad\widetilde\nu_t=\frac1N\sum_{i=1}^N\nu_{it}\quad\text{and}\quad\widetilde\epsilon_t=\frac1N\sum_{i=1}^N\epsilon_{it},
\]
where we suppress their dependence on $N$. From the model formulation (3.1), we have
\[
\widetilde X_t=\widetilde\nu_t+\widetilde\epsilon_t,\quad t=1,\cdots,T.
\]
(3.2)
